title: price SKU WN-10 through the legacy catalog path and confirm the pager end
goal: Open the legacy /catalog path, which redirects to the parts list, extract the price cell of SKU WN-10 from page 1, open page 2 directly to confirm the pager ends there, return to page 1 with back, and report the price.

gold.intent: load the legacy catalog path and read where its redirect lands
page 1 of the parts list is shown; find the WN-10 row to read its price
the row text showed the price; find the cell holding exactly that text
extract the price cell so the value is logged as evidence
the page 1 snapshot showed a pager; load page 2 directly to inspect where it ends
page 2 says it is the last page; verify no Next page link exists before stopping
the pager ended; go back to page 1 where the extracted price was read
the extracted price is logged and page 1 is shown again; report the result

recovery.intent: the legacy path loops; load the canonical parts list path the goal names
the typed page-2 address returned Page not found; go back to the listing
the listing shows its pager; find the Next page link rather than typing a url
the pager link ref is in the find result; click it to reach page 2
